# SQL Query to Retrieve Budget by Department

Here are several SQL query options to retrieve budget information by department, depending on your database structure:

## Basic Query (Assuming a simple department_budget table)

```sql
SELECT
    department_id,
    department_name,
    budget_amount,
    fiscal_year
FROM
    department_budgets
ORDER BY
    department_name;
```

## Query with Department Details (Joining with departments table)

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_id,
    d.department_name,
    d.location,
    b.budget_amount,
    b.fiscal_year,
    b.currency
FROM
    departments d
JOIN
    department_budgets b ON d.department_id = b.department_id
ORDER BY
    d.department_name, b.fiscal_year;
```

## Query with Budget Breakdown by Category

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    bc.category_name,
    SUM(b.amount) AS category_budget
FROM
    departments d
JOIN
    budget_items b ON d.department_id = b.department_id
JOIN
    budget_categories bc ON b.category_id = bc.category_id
GROUP BY
    d.department_name, bc.category_name
ORDER BY
    d.department_name, category_budget DESC;
```

## Query with Year-over-Year Comparison

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    b1.fiscal_year AS current_year,
    b1.budget_amount AS current_budget,
    b2.fiscal_year AS previous_year,
    b2.budget_amount AS previous_budget,
    (b1.budget_amount - b2.budget_amount) AS budget_change,
    ROUND(((b1.budget_amount - b2.budget_amount) / b2.budget_amount) * 100, 2) AS percent_change
FROM
    department_budgets b1
JOIN
    department_budgets b2 ON b1.department_id = b2.department_id
JOIN
    departments d ON b1.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE
    b1.fiscal_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)
    AND b2.fiscal_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
ORDER BY
    d.department_name;
```

## Query with Actual vs Budget Comparison

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    b.fiscal_year,
    b.budget_amount,
    SUM(a.actual_amount) AS actual_spent,
    (b.budget_amount - SUM(a.actual_amount)) AS variance,
    ROUND((SUM(a.actual_amount) / b.budget_amount) * 100, 2) AS percent_used
FROM
    departments d
JOIN
    department_budgets b ON d.department_id = b.department_id
LEFT JOIN
    actual_expenses a ON d.department_id = a.department_id AND b.fiscal_year = a.fiscal_year
GROUP BY
    d.department_name, b.fiscal_year, b.budget_amount
ORDER BY
    d.department_name, b.fiscal_year;
```
